output.narrative:
The fill_rate metric increased by 0.0283 (relative delta 0.0283) during the baseline window of 2026-06-29 compared to current window 2026-07-06. The primary drivers of the revenue delta of 3344.97 were requests (contributing 3708.82) and fill_rate (contributing 165.21). 

The fill_rate movement was primarily driven by two independent segments: category=utility (explanatory power 0.225, lift 1.94) and os_version=iOS 18.1 (explanatory power 0.176, lift 1.83). 

Within category=utility, checking ad formats and other dimensions ruled out the video segment (explanatory power 0.08, lift 0.64). Within os_version=iOS 18.1, the movement was further concentrated in region=APAC (explanatory power 0.574, lift 2.46) and country=JP (explanatory power 0.293, lift 2.9). 

Other dimensions like ad_format=video (lift 0.17) and category=news (lift 0.91) were checked and ruled out as having low explanatory power or proportional movement.
